title: Something Sat Next To Me On The Last Bus #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you catch the last bus home. It's empty.
You sit at the back and put in your earphones.
At the next stop, nobody gets on. But the doors open.
The seat beside you sinks. Like someone sat down.
The window fogs up, next to that seat.
A finger draws a smiley face on the glass.
You move to the front. Your heart is pounding.
In the driver's mirror, you see the back seat.
*Someone is sitting there. Waving at you.
The driver says, "Your friend isn't getting off?"
Would you ask the driver what he sees, or jump off? Comment A or B.
